keyEvents.text: Goal! Burnley 0, Birmingham City 1. August Priske (Birmingham City) left footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Jay Stansfield.
Jhon Solís (Birmingham City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jaydon Banel (Burnley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Burnley 0, Birmingham City 1.
Second Half begins Burnley 0, Birmingham City 1.
Own Goal by Jaydon Banel, Burnley. Burnley 0, Birmingham City 2.
Alex Cochrane (Birmingham City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Burnley. Andréas Hountondji replaces Aaron Ramsey.
Substitution, Burnley. Ugo Raghouber replaces Reo Hatate.
Largie Ramazani (Burnley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Max Bird replaces Jay Stansfield.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Demarai Gray replaces Liam Millar.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Paik Seung-Ho replaces Jhon Solís.
Substitution, Burnley. Marcus Edwards replaces Jaydon Banel.
Substitution, Burnley. Jamie Vardy replaces Zeki Amdouni.
Ugo Raghouber (Burnley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Luis Vázquez replaces August Priske.
Max Alleyne (Burnley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty saved. Demarai Gray (Birmingham City) right footed shot saved in the bottom right corner by Max Weiss (Burnley).
Marcus Edwards (Burnley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Taylor Gardner-Hickman replaces Carlos Vicente.
